_comment: Copy this file to mcp_servers.json (gitignored) and fill in real values. Each top-level key is a server name; its tools are exposed to Jarvis as mcp_<name>_<tool>. Restart jarvis.py (or wait for the next process start — servers connect once, lazily) to pick up changes.

gmail._comment: One-time setup before this works: enable the Gmail API in Google Cloud Console, create an OAuth client (type: Desktop app), download it as gcp-oauth.keys.json into ~/.gmail-mcp/, then run `npx @gongrzhe/server-gmail-autoauth-mcp auth` once to consent via browser. After that, jarvis.py just needs this entry.

calendar._comment: Reuses the same gcp-oauth.keys.json as gmail above (same Google Cloud project) -- just also enable the Google Calendar API, then run `npx @cocal/google-calendar-mcp auth` once.

discord._comment: WARNING: this is a self-bot -- it acts as your personal Discord account (DMs, servers you're in), which violates Discord's Terms of Service and carries real account-ban risk (see README). Server implementation: discord_selfbot_server.py in this repo, not a third-party package. Get your token from discord.com -> DevTools (F12) -> Application -> Local Storage -> the "token" value. Never share this token anywhere else -- it's full, unscoped account access.

browser._comment: No credentials needed. Official Microsoft package -- real browser automation (navigate, click, type, fill forms, screenshots, page snapshots).
